subject: skill:review
gist: Each reviewer gets the one brief and its numbered report
reason: Each reviewer gets the one brief every fresh agent gets with review's extras, writes review-<n>.md and delegates nothing. Review takes its own fix pass, and without delegation its independent and looped depths run inline.

authorisedBy.words: The operator's cards of 2026-10-14 on part 3 of the-whole-change, each "Rule as proposed": one agent at a time through the harness's delegation, in the change's one checkout and never a worktree; one brief for every fresh agent, the change's front matter, its acceptance, its id, the path of its report and the skill it works by, then the step's extras, and no fresh agent delegates; every fresh agent's report is <step>-<n>.md in the change's folder; the fix rounds are per step, and a fix after verify is not reviewed again outside a loop without the owner's word; verify's verdicts stand as the agent gave them; and where the harness has no delegation the block's fallback runs every depth above written
